records.body: This animal has short yellow fur. It prefers protein-based food rather than grain-based food. It has small white spots on its face, above the eyes. Its hands and stomach are covered with short white fur. It has a tail. It wags its tail when it feels happy. Its nose has tiny pores. Its origin is known as Japan. What is this?
